title: Turning tracking on marks the first bin as default when none is
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test with 2 in bin location A (the first bin row) and 5 in bin location B, saved with neither bin marked Default.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inventory section lists bin location A with 2 as the first row and bin location B with 5 as the second; neither row is marked Default.

Step 2:

  • The first bin row, bin location A, is now marked Default and bin location B is not.
  • The quantities are unchanged: 2 and 5.

Step 3:

  • The window closes with no bin error.
  • Part A's Total Qty shows 7 Available (2 + 5 = 7), and Bin Location / Quantity shows bin location A with 2 and bin location B with 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R8: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the dialog marks the first one as the default.”
  • S5-E2: “A part reaches S5-R8 with bin locations and no default in two ways: the bin location that was its default is deleted in Administration → Bin Locations while the part holds 0 there, or an untracked part is saved with bin locations and none marked default.”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 5: “Save an untracked part with bins and none marked default, then turn tracking on.”
